A bounded change to something that already exists, finished in less than a sprint, that doesn't advance a roadmap goal. It lives on the small request board and is worked from the Small requests share of capacity.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Small request](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [08 Request triage and the idea log](/system/request-triage-and-idea-log)
- **Owner:** product owner
- **Links to:** [Roadmap](/templates/roadmap) (Small requests capacity row)

## Template

A small request is a ticket, the way an IT service desk handles one. Keep it that light.

| Field | What goes here |
|---|---|
| Title | Short name of the change |
| Description | What exists today and the change asked for, in the requester's words |
| Requested by | Person and team |
| Status | Ready → In sprint → Done → Requester told |
| Urgency | Normal by default. Urgent only if it should jump the line: say why and who decided |

The ticket tool stamps the date it was submitted. That date sets its place in line: the board runs first in, first out.

## DMV example

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Title | Sticker arrival date on confirmation page |
| Description | The renewal confirmation page doesn't say when the sticker arrives. Add "Your sticker will arrive within 10 business days." About 40 calls a week ask this. |
| Requested by | Call center lead |
| Status | Requester told (done in Sprint 3) |
| Urgency | Normal |
